title: Possible AWS access key ID in source
description: A string with the shape of an AWS access key ID (AKIA followed by 16 characters) was found in source. The ID alone cannot authenticate — the secret access key is separate — but its presence means cloud credentials may live in version control.
remediation: If this is a real key ID, find the matching secret key, revoke both in IAM, and move credentials to environment variables or a secret manager loaded at runtime. Rotate anything the key could access.
limitation: Shape-only: matches the AKIA prefix format, which cannot prove a live credential. Documentation/example keys are vetoed by the denylist. The secret access key itself (40-char base64) is a separate rule.

tests.line: aws_access_key_id = "AKIA-SHORT"  # docs example, too short to match
